description: BOOLAND(x, y) over three-valued logic: both true is TRUE, either false is FALSE, FALSE dominates even against NULL, and TRUE with NULL is NULL. The BOOL* family is defined over NUMBER / VARCHAR / VARIANT truthiness and NOT over BOOLEAN, so Snowflake rejects BOOLAND(TRUE, FALSE) outright (live-verified). Converted 1:1 from functions/BoolAndTest (now retired).
